title: Device Tracking & Stability Patch
headline: Device IDs are now permanently recorded the moment the app opens — admins get accurate device history for every user, and the Device Inspector works reliably for all account types.
changes: Fixed: Device ID is now captured and permanently stored on every app launch — no longer lost when plans change or devices are rebound.
Fixed: Device ID header was silently dropped from authentication calls due to an internal URL routing issue — now correctly included on all cloud requests.
New: Admin Device Inspector — search any device ID or email to see full device history, linked accounts, risk flags, and live status.
Improved: Device records survive plan changes, resets, and rebinds — giving admins a complete permanent audit trail.
Fixed: Free and trial users now have their device IDs tracked from first launch, not just premium users.
